items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: The other publisher there, Bennett was the name. Theron C. Bennett published that.

ctx.x: Well, Memphis is the one he lost.

Memphis is the one. Well, he got it back eventually. They didn't find it. He renewed it. He renewed it and got it. He renewed it and got it, yes. He came down here to the library and was so pleased when he made that renewal. It had a piece in the paper about it. It said his face shone and he was glad to get hold of that piece again. That's true. The other publisher there, Bennett was the name. Theron C. Bennett published that. I think he was out in Kansas City or someplace like that when he did it. But he went to…
Well, that was a copyrighted publishing date on that was September 26, 1940.
